ModMetadata.Name: Stationeers UI Ascended
ModMetadata.Author: FlorpyDorp + JXSN
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers UI Ascended[/h1]
A UI overhaul that rebuilds Stationeers' inventory and HUD around your two hands: radial wheels for tools, bags, gear and devices; a Universal Inventory with every bag you carry in one window; a Smart Stow that sends each item back to the exact slot it came from; and a curved suit-visor HUD you can redesign live in the F9 HUD Designer. No hotbar, ever. Every inventory action goes through the game's own server-checked path, so it plays fair in multiplayer. [h3]Four themes ship in the box - Stationeers Blue, Stationeers Blue Minimalist, Zirillian Red and Pure HUD. Press F10 for settings, F9 for the HUD Designer.[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
Stationeers UI Ascended WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
Stationeers UI Ascended - Radial wheels for tools, bags, gear and devices, the Universal Inventory, a Smart Stow that remembers where things go, and a two-hand visor HUD. No hotbar, and the game's own physical inventory rules stay intact.

Reshape the visor live in the F9 HUD Designer: move, resize and restyle anything, give it a different look when suited or bare, and save it as your own theme. The wheels, the Universal Inventory and the F10 Control Center all retint with the active theme. Four themes ship: Stationeers Blue, Stationeers Blue Minimalist, Zirillian Red and Pure HUD. Found a bug? F10 - Suggestions/Bugs.
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 1.0.1 -- HUD size, Hydration, Vulkan and DX12:[/h3] [list] [*] HUD SIZE THAT HOLDS TOGETHER: the Overall HUD scale (F9 - Global) now scales the HUD in groups. Things that sit together grow together from the screen corner or edge they are nearest, and a group stops growing where it would run off the screen or into another group -- no more boxes sliding over each other or drifting apart. At a theme's own size nothing changes [*] Hydration shows its real value above 100% (up to 175%) instead of stopping at 100% [*] Vulkan and DirectX 12 (-force-vulkan, -force-d3d12): the glass and glow effects now work there instead of drawing pink squares, and any graphics mode that cannot run them falls back to plain panels [/list] [h3]Version 1.0.0 -- UI Ascended 1.0:[/h3] [list] [*] SMART STOW THAT REMEMBERS (the new default, Simple mode): every item remembers the exact bag and slot you last put it in, in each world, and G sends it back there -- even into a belt inside a backpack. Moving an item by hand moves its home; G, sorting and swaps never steal it. Players who already use Bag Profiles stay on the rule system, now called Complex mode, with a one-time notice [*] NEW IN-GAME TUTORIAL: 19 short lessons. A Welcome card offers a guided tour of the whole mod or lessons that appear the first time you need them, and every lesson can be watched, tried or replayed from F10 - Guide [*] F10 CONTROL CENTER REBUILT: a bigger window with manila folder tabs, a settings search box, the last tab remembered, and More options sections instead of Simple/Advanced. HUD Themes is now UI Themes, the Radial tab gains every wheel colour and glass setting, and Storage is now SmartStow with a three-column Organizer (Storage Layouts, Bags, Bag Profiles). Stow Profiles are now Storage Layouts; the shipped Stationpedia Ascended layout is now Ascended (your edits are kept). Equipped tool belts and jetpacks can take Bag Profiles [*] REPORT BUGS IN-GAME: the new F10 Suggestions/Bugs tab sends a bug or idea straight to the developers as a tracked report -- optionally with your HUD profile or recent log lines -- and shows its status. Anonymous unless you add a contact. Also available as the uiafeedback console command [*] WHEELS: an action word (TAKE / EQUIP / SWAP / OPEN / STOW) shows what a click will do; closing a wheel by any route drops what you dragged out at your feet; a curved, theme-coloured hint ring with clearer wording; bold item names and a Recent item tag; the 6 key opens the full Belt Wheel with The Hub and belt change; hidden built-in slots stay hidden [*] UNIVERSAL INVENTORY: drag into chargers, lockers and other world containers, also from a hand box; Shift+drag moves every stack of a type; compact split buttons including choose-a-number (host/single-player); overlapping popups fixed; a rescue cell recovers items trapped in stacks by old saves [*] HUD: a new Rangefinder element you can add in F9; the low-battery glitch now starts at 10% on the shipped themes; removed a debug line that spammed the log every 1.5 seconds [*] Under the hood: per-world data is now keyed to the world ID, so multiplayer clients no longer mix data between servers; verified against the current game build [/list] [h3]Version 0.9.7.4 EXPERIMENTAL -- four shipped themes + play-test round 4:[/h3] [list] [*] FOUR shipped HUD themes, all at their newest versions: Stationeers Blue, Stationeers Blue Minimalist, Zirillian Red and Pure HUD. Shipped themes are now read-only in the editors (duplicate one to customize it), and the new uiadev console command unlocks them for theme authoring [*] Shift+1-6 (or a mouse-modifier click on a HUD gear box) now opens that worn container INSIDE the Universal Inventory; if you pinned it into its own window yourself, it brings the pinned window forward instead [*] Alert glow fixes: a red CRITICAL pulse no longer washes out to white/pink at high brightness on older profiles, and the glow stays visible while the F9 designer is open so you can actually tune it [*] F9 designer: a Pause button in the toolbar (single-player; auto-resumes when you close F9), and the editor + element popup now draw above the mod's own HUD elements [*] New F10 - HUD - Maintenance - Repair config folders button: non-destructively recreates any missing config folders/files; every store now also survives its folder being deleted mid-session [/list] [h3]Version 0.9.7.3 EXPERIMENTAL -- play-test round 3:[/h3] [list] [*] Toolbelt wedge bindings are STICKY: swapping a tool from the wheel into your hand no longer steals the wedge binding -- the displaced hand tool returns to its own bound wedge instead of squatting in the taken tool's slot (click AND drag). Bindings only ever move when you deliberately drag tools over each other in the wheel or drag one onto a wedge [*] Smart-stow (G) no longer strands the build hologram: stowing the item you were building with now exits build mode properly -- this also fixes the same ghost in vanilla's own G-stow branch [*] New option (F10 - Radials - Behaviour): invert what Shift means -- wheels can now default to STAYING OPEN after every action, with Shift closing them instead. Default unchanged [*] Vanilla's F2 tips panel now always draws ON TOP of the mod's UI (HUD, wheels, Universal Inventory) -- while still sitting behind the Esc menu and other vanilla menus [/list] [h3]Older versions: see the Change Notes tab on the Steam Workshop page.[/h3]
